description: Resubmit (rerun) an existing Code Engine job run using the same configuration. If the original run referenced a job definition, the same job is run again; if it was an ad-hoc run, its inline configuration (image, command, scaling, env) is replicated.

job_run_name.description: Name of the existing job run to resubmit

name.description: Optional name for the new job run

name: ce_resubmit_job_run
